prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1028; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described in your file. Our client was hurt in a low-speed head-on impact and is now receiving medical treatment for injuries sustained in the crash. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We ask that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including the bodily injury liability limits and any other coverage that may apply to this loss. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists under the same policyholder.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle inspection reports, telematics or event data recorder downloads, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster communications, and any repair or total loss valuation records. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
